records.title: Realified tensor networks: quantum circuit simulation on real-valued matrix accelerators

records.title: Pairwise-Independent Dithering for Single-Stage Hadamard Quantization
records.reason: Primary abstract: Quantizing high-dimensional vectors is fundamental to similarity search, distributed learning, and model compression. Feng, Indyk, Kapralov, Krachun, and Prokhorov established sharp guarantees for an unbiased dithered quantizer based on a randomized Hadamard t Vector quantization for similarity search/distributed learning, not LLM weights/KV.

records.title: AtumAI: A Principled Framework for Agentic Generation of Datacenter Control-Plane Policies
records.reason: Primary abstract: The efficiency of a datacenter rests on its control plane policies. Designing these policies is increasingly hard: the hardware-software stack grows fast, the design space is vast and interdependent, and prototyping a single policy takes months. Agentic AI pro Agentic generation of datacenter control policies is not inference-serving optimization.
